use_case: Dam-safety sensor anomaly detection: a machine learning model in the DSMS (SYS-E1) flags unusual piezometer, seepage, deformation, and level patterns for review by dam safety engineers, for 68 Hydro dams and 19 pilot client dams
business_owner: Director of Data Science (model and service); Vice President, Dam Safety (Chief Dam Safety Engineer) for use at Hydro dams; each client's dam safety engineer for client dams
vendor_or_model: In-house model built by Engineering, trained on historical readings and 51 documented events from Hydro and consenting client dams
data_categories: Dam safety instrument readings; reservoir and tailwater levels; rainfall; no personal information. Alerts that describe failure modes are client CEII or Hydro CEII
human_in_the_loop: Advisory only. Every alert is reviewed by a dam safety engineer or technician, who checks the instrument; the Chief Dam Safety Engineer (or the client's engineer) decides any action, 12.10 report, or EAP step. Rules-based thresholds and trigger-point checks keep running. Manual reading schedules may not be reduced because of AI-001 without council and ODSP approval
applicable_laws: 18 CFR 12.10(a) and 12.3(b)(4)(viii) (C-DAMS-R02); 18 CFR 12.51; 18 CFR 12.62(d)(3) and 12.64 (ODSP); FERC Security Program Rev. 3A Sec. 3.2 trigger points (C-DAMS-R01); DSMS client contracts (security schedule sec. 7; AI-001 pilot addendum); FTC Act Sec. 5 (15 U.S.C. 45(a)) for performance claims
status: Approved by the council 2025-09 for assistive use; Hydro reliance increased in 2026-02 without re-approval; continued with conditions 2026-08-27 (P10 section 6). In production for Hydro since 2025-10; pilot with 19 clients since 2026-03; pilot expansion paused

use_case: Inflow and reservoir forecasting: machine learning forecasts of inflows for day-ahead schedules and reservoir release planning at the 41 HOC-operated developments
vendor_or_model: In-house model on the scheduling platform (SYS-H6), using gauge, weather, and historian data received one-way from OT
data_categories: River and rain gauge data; weather forecasts; reservoir levels; no personal information
human_in_the_loop: Schedulers and HOC staff approve every schedule and release plan. Flood operations follow the license operating rules, the EAPs, and engineer decisions; the forecast is one input. No automatic link to gate commands
applicable_laws: FERC license operating conditions (generic, per project); 18 CFR 12.20 and 12.22 (EAPs unchanged by the forecast); NERC GOP scheduling obligations to the Balancing Authorities (operating agreements)
status: Approved by the council 2025-11; in production

use_case: Unit condition monitoring: anomaly scoring of vibration, temperature, and efficiency data to plan turbine and generator maintenance
vendor_or_model: Predictive maintenance module of the plant maintenance system, configured by Hydro; runs on corporate infrastructure from historian copies
data_categories: Unit sensor data copied from historians; maintenance records; no personal information
human_in_the_loop: Maintenance engineers review every recommendation before a work order is raised; no connection back to plant controls
applicable_laws: CIP-013-2 supply chain terms for the module vendor (C-DAMS-R03); POL-01 4.13
status: Approved by the council 2026-03; in production at 22 plants

use_case: Inspection imagery defect detection: the field inspection app marks possible cracks, spalling, and seepage in drone and ROV imagery for inspectors
vendor_or_model: Inspection app vendor's computer vision model (vendor SaaS, SYS-E3)
data_categories: Drone and ROV imagery of client and Hydro dams (CEII); inspector notes
human_in_the_loop: Inspectors review every image, not only the marked ones; the sealing engineer owns every finding. The tool may not be used to skip images in Part 12D inspections
applicable_laws: 18 CFR 12.35 and 12.36 for Part 12D work for other licensees (the independent consultant owns findings); client NDAs passing through 18 CFR 388.113 CEII terms; state engineering licensure (generic)
status: In use on client inspections since 2026-05 without council review; council review due 2026-11-19; imagery terms with the vendor under renegotiation (EN-013)

use_case: Jobsite computer vision safety cameras: detect missing hard hats, harnesses, and exclusion-zone entries and alert the site safety manager
vendor_or_model: Camera vendor's computer vision service (vendor SaaS)
data_categories: Video of workers on jobsites (personal information); safety events; footage retained 30 days
consequential_decision_category: None directly; re-tier to Employment if alerts are ever used for individual discipline
human_in_the_loop: Site safety manager reviews each alert and coaches the crew; no individual identification or discipline from camera alerts
applicable_laws: Collective bargaining agreements (contract); state employee monitoring and biometric laws in each state where cameras are used (counsel review; facial recognition disabled); state AI employment laws if use changes (for example Colorado SB26-189, effective 2027-01-01)
status: Pilot at 12 jobsites without council review; no expansion until reviewed (council 2026-11-19)

use_case: AI estimating assistant: drafts quantities and unit prices from drawings and historical bids
vendor_or_model: Estimating vendor's assistant in SYS-C5 (vendor SaaS)
data_categories: Bid documents, drawings (some owner CEII), historical pricing (Confidential)
human_in_the_loop: Estimators review every line; the bid manager approves every bid
applicable_laws: Owner contract and NDA terms; POL-04 4.9 (no CUI or CEII unless the tool is approved for that class); FAR and DFARS clauses keep CUI in the FPE
status: In use since 2026-04 without council review; CUI and owner CEII prohibited in the tool pending review (council 2026-11-19)

use_case: Engineering drafting assistant: drafts report text and summaries from engineer notes, using the enterprise assistant configured with Engineering report templates
vendor_or_model: Enterprise generative AI assistant (no-training terms) with Engineering templates
data_categories: Engineer notes and draft reports; client CEII only in the restricted tenant configuration
human_in_the_loop: Sealing engineer reviews all content; no AI for calculations; AI-assisted drafting noted in the quality checklist
applicable_laws: State engineering licensure (generic, each state where work is sealed); client NDAs (18 CFR 388.113 terms); POL-05 4.9
status: Approved by the council 2026-05 with conditions; disclosure rule in the quality checklist due 2026-12-31 (EG-019)

use_case: Enterprise generative AI assistant for the workforce (drafting, summarizing internal documents)
data_categories: Internal documents; CEII, BCSI, and CUI prohibited
human_in_the_loop: Users review all outputs; prohibited for dam safety, grid operations, and decisions about people
applicable_laws: POL-05 4.9; POL-04 4.9; CIP-011-3 R1 for BCSI (C-DAMS-R03); DFARS 252.204-7012(b) for CUI (N23-R03)
status: Approved by the council 2026-04 for about 9,000 users in selected roles; DLP rules for CEII, BCSI, and CUI markings due 2026-12-31 (GR-17)

use_case: Coding assistant for DSMS and corporate software developers
data_categories: Source code; no client data, CEII, BCSI, or CUI
human_in_the_loop: Developers review all suggestions; normal code review applies

use_case: SOC alert triage assistant: summarizes and ranks SIEM alerts, including OT sensor alerts from the HOCs and 14 plants
vendor_or_model: SIEM vendor's AI assistant feature (enabled by a 2026-06 product update)
data_categories: Security alerts and logs, including BCSI from OT sensors
human_in_the_loop: Analysts review every ranked alert; incident declaration and every reporting determination stay with people (POL-03)
applicable_laws: CIP-011-3 R1 (BCSI handled by the SIEM vendor) and CIP-013-2 terms (C-DAMS-R03); CIP-008-6 R4 determinations stay with the NERC Compliance Director
status: Enabled 2026-06 without council review; OT alert data excluded from the feature until reviewed (council 2026-11-19)
